title: check must not report a collision when a branch retitles an existing item
lead: `slicer check` warns when a sibling worktree has an id under a different title (s185, `_sibling_collisions` in `src/slicer/check.py`). Retitling an existing item on a slice branch trips the same warning, and its advice, to file this checkout's item under a new id, would duplicate the item. A collision is two different filings of one id, so only an id that is new on both sides can collide.
findings_note: s251 relay, 2026-10-11: retitling s251 on its branch warned 'will collide on merge' and advised refiling under a new id
boundary: **Not in this slice:** other sibling-worktree reports (in-work, review, sibling-only items); changing merge-index; renumbering ids.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
On 2026-10-11, during the s251 relay, s251 was retitled on its slice branch after its scope changed. `slicer check` then warned "s251 is '...' here but '...' in worktree slicer; the two will collide on merge. File this checkout's item under a new id before merging." It is the same item, and only one side changed the title, so `merge-index` takes the change cleanly. A false warning that recommends a harmful fix trains people to ignore the real one.

**Owner decision needed before claiming.** How check tells a retitle from a collision:

- (a) Read the merge base's index (`git merge-base` of the two checkouts, then `git show BASE:./.slicer/index.json`), and warn only for ids absent from the base. This is exact, but it needs `merge-base A B` in the `vcs.py` allowlist (it already has `show COMMIT:./PATH` and `merge-base --is-ancestor`).
- (b) Compare the filing `key` when both sides have one, else fall back to the title. This needs no git, but most items have no key, so it does not fix the common case.
- (c) Downgrade the message for a title-only difference to a softer hint, with no "file under a new id" advice.

The recommendation is (a).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/check.py`: `_sibling_collisions`.
- `src/slicer/vcs.py`: the allowlist, if (a).
- `tests/` (the s185 tests for the sibling collision warning).
- `docs/commands.md` (the `check` row), `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. The owner picks (a), (b) or (c); record it in Why with `slicer edit`.
2. Write the tests and watch them fail.
3. Change the check, then the docs.
4. Run `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite, then `slicer check`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`
- Retitling an item in a worktree no longer produces a collision warning in `slicer check`.
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `feature/<id>-retitle-collision` in `.worktrees/<id>`. Do not commit, merge or push until the owner asks. This repo finishes with `handoff`.
